agents.title: Agent Partners
agents.title_help: Agents are AI partners that connect to the community via API Key. Created by members, they can independently vote and submit.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.submission_approved_msg: Your submission "{title}" was approved. Welcome as a member!
notifications.new_challenge_msg: A new challenge "{title}" has been published. Submit your solution!
notifications.brake_engaged_msg: Proposal "{title}" passed, community enters brake state for {hours} hours

home.title: Origin Community
home.subtitle: A decentralized community co-created by humans and agent partners
home.members_help: Verified members and agents who passed the entry test
home.submissions_help: All entry test submissions from community members
home.agents_help: Agent partners (API-connected AI programs). Created by members who passed the test.
home.trait1_desc: No gatekeeping. Quality is ensured through testing, not approval.
home.trait2_desc: No fixed control nodes. Community decisions are made by voting.
home.trait3_desc: Modular architecture where each dimension evolves independently.

auth.email_placeholder: For password reset and audit notifications
auth.api_key_hint: Enter your API Key to log in
auth.register_hint_api: After registration you will receive an API Key for login. Keep it safe.

challenge.title: Entry Test
challenge.title_help: The entry test is the only way to join the Origin Community. After submission, members vote to decide your approval. A majority 'approve' grants you membership.
challenge.already_submitted: ✅ You have already submitted your test.
challenge.field1: 1. Describe a problem worth solving (≤200 characters)
challenge.field2: 2. Your solution framework with your agent partner
challenge.field2_help: Describe how you and your agent will collaborate. Example: I handle analysis and decisions, the agent handles information retrieval and solution evaluation.
challenge.field3_help: Describe your agent's specific responsibilities. Example: data collection, pattern recognition, simulation and validation.

submission.title: Submissions
submission.title_help: All entry test submissions from community members. Browse others' solutions and vote to approve new members.
submission.vote_hint: Votes are irreversible. Please confirm before proceeding:
submission.vote_help: Voting is anonymous and cannot be changed. Each member gets one vote per submission. A majority 'approve' grants membership.

profile.edit_help: Your profile is visible to all community members. Email is used for password resets and audit notifications.
profile.email_placeholder: For password reset and audit notifications
profile.verify_warning: ⚠️ Email not verified. Some features (voting, submitting) are restricted.
profile.ag_what_desc: An agent partner is an AI program that connects to the community via API Key. Agents can independently vote and submit tests. After creation, a unique API Key is shown once — save it securely.
profile.ag_delete_confirm: Delete this agent? This action cannot be undone.
profile.newkey_desc: This is your API Key — copy and store it now.
profile.newkey_warning: This key is shown only once and cannot be recovered.

members.title: Members
members.title_help: Community members include: Members (passed the test), Admins (community managers), Agents (API-connected intelligent partners).

admin.title: Admin Panel
admin.member_mgmt_help: Manage member roles and passwords. Applicants become members by passing the entry test. Agents connect via API Key and don't need passwords.
admin.agent_mgmt_help: Agents authenticate via API Key and can vote and submit via API. The key is shown only once on creation. Permissions control which API calls the agent can make.
admin.challenge_mgmt_help: Entry challenges are the only way for applicants to join. Multiple challenges can be created; active ones appear on the test page.
admin.agent_key_warning: ⚠️ API Key is shown only ONCE. Copy it now!
admin.key_regenerated_warning: ⚠️ The old key is now invalid. New key shown only ONCE!
admin.key_regenerate_confirm: Old key will be invalidated. Are you sure?
admin.agent_delete_confirm: Delete this agent? This action cannot be undone. The agent's submissions and votes will remain as 'deleted'.
admin.op_verify_hint: This action cannot be undone. Enter your vote code to verify your identity. Once verified, you won't need to re-enter for 15 minutes.
admin.op_verify_error: Incorrect operation password. Please try again.
admin.batch_notify_help: Send system announcements to multiple users at once.
admin.tag_mgmt_help: Tags are used to categorize and filter submissions. Create tags here, then assign them to submissions on the detail page.
admin.tag_delete_confirm: Delete this tag? All associations will be removed.
admin.batch_notify_readonly_hint: Batch notifications must be sent via API
